key: Oh! Excuse me, did I see you during the chaos with Team Meteor around here?
en: Oh! Excuse me, did I see you during the chaos with Team Meteor around here?
ja: あら! ごめんなさい、あなたのこと、チームメテオの騒動のときこの辺りで見かけたかしら?

key: Regardless, I'm glad you're doing well, friend!
en: Regardless, I'm glad you're doing well, friend!
ja: それはともかく、元気そうで何よりだわ!

key: Everyone in this city now has struggled a lot, but we've all been able to come together because of it!
en: Everyone in this city now has struggled a lot, but we've all been able to come together because of it!
ja: この街の誰もが大変な思いをしてきたけど、そのおかげでみんなで力を合わせられたのよ!

key: Welcome to the Beryl Library!
en: Welcome to the Beryl Library!
ja: ベリル図書館へようこそ!

key: Feel free to have a look around, and ask myself or Gothitelle if you need any help.
en: Feel free to have a look around, and ask myself or Gothitelle if you need any help.
ja: 自由に見て回ってね。何か困ったら、わたしかゴチルゼルに聞いて。

key: We're also accepting new hires.
en: We're also accepting new hires.
ja: 新しいスタッフも募集中なの。

key: If you're interested in helping out, feel free to take an application.
en: If you're interested in helping out, feel free to take an application.
ja: 手伝ってみたいなら、遠慮せず申込書を持っていってね。

key: Huh?
en: Huh?
ja: あれ?

key: For some reason I thought there used to be an upper floor here...
en: For some reason I thought there used to be an upper floor here...
ja: なぜか、ここには昔、上の階があったような気がするのよね……

key: Maybe all the information there was moved to other places?
en: Maybe all the information there was moved to other places?
ja: そこにあった情報は、どこか他の場所に移されたのかしら?

key: Awwh, you're so cute!
en: Awwh, you're so cute!
ja: あら、なんてかわいいの!

key: Ah, I've missed this old place.
en: Ah, I've missed this old place.
ja: ああ、この古い場所が恋しかったわ。

key: Quite peculiar, it is.
en: Quite peculiar, it is.
ja: なかなか奇妙な場所よね。

key: No one's quite sure who owns the property, but everyone knows that Gothitelle tends to it.
en: No one's quite sure who owns the property, but everyone knows that Gothitelle tends to it.
ja: この建物の持ち主が誰なのか、はっきりわかっている人はいないけど、ゴチルゼルが世話をしているのはみんな知ってるわ。

key: I remember, even back when I first came to Reborn, that little Gothorita that was always helping people out here.
en: I remember, even back when I first came to Reborn, that little Gothorita that was always helping people out here.
ja: わたしが初めてリボーンに来たときから、あの小さなゴチミルが、いつもここで人を助けていたのを覚えているの。

key: It doesn't talk about its past, but I can't help to think that maybe it once belonged to the person who founded this library.
en: It doesn't talk about its past, but I can't help to think that maybe it once belonged to the person who founded this library.
ja: 自分の過去について話してくれたことはないけど、もしかしたらこの図書館を設立した人が飼っていたポケモンなんじゃないかって、つい思ってしまうの。

key: Of course, that has its own implications...
en: Of course, that has its own implications...
ja: もちろん、それにはそれで、いろいろと意味することがあるけれど……

key: A stack of job applications for the Beryl Library sits on the counter.
en: A stack of job applications for the Beryl Library sits on the counter.
ja: カウンターにはベリル図書館の求人申込書が積んである。

key: Take one?
en: Take one?
ja: 1枚　取りますか?

key: DEFACTO: \PN! Salutations!
en: DEFACTO: \PN! Salutations!
ja: デファクト：\PN! やあ、こんにちは!

key: Lovely to see you again!
en: Lovely to see you again!
ja: また会えてうれしいよ!

key: I've settled in quite swimmingly.
en: I've settled in quite swimmingly.
ja: すっかりなじんでうまくやっているよ。

key: Thank you for the lead.
en: Thank you for the lead.
ja: 紹介してくれてありがとう。

key: If you require any assistance, please ask myself or one of the other staff members.
en: If you require any assistance, please ask myself or one of the other staff members.
ja: 何か助けが必要なら、僕か他のスタッフに聞いてくれ。

key: Ah, but, I suggest you not be late on returning your borrowed books.
en: Ah, but, I suggest you not be late on returning your borrowed books.
ja: ああ、でも、借りた本の返却が遅れないようにしたほうがいいよ。

key: I've implemented a new policy on late returns... Aqua Gang style.
en: I've implemented a new policy on late returns... Aqua Gang style.
ja: 延滞に対する新しい方針を導入したんだ……アクアギャング流にね。

key: It's really worked wonders.
en: It's really worked wonders.
ja: これが本当によく効くんだ。

key: By the way, I'm still in the Blast Powder business. It's just a little more under the table.
en: By the way, I'm still in the Blast Powder business. It's just a little more under the table.
ja: ところで、僕は今もばくはつのこなの商売を続けているよ。ちょっと裏に回っただけでね。

key: If you're in need, I can always hook you up.
en: If you're in need, I can always hook you up.
ja: 必要なら、いつでも都合をつけるよ。

key: DEFACTO: You're back!
en: DEFACTO: You're back!
ja: デファクト：戻ってきたね!

key: So what'll it be-- pages or powder?
en: So what'll it be-- pages or powder?
ja: それで、どっちにする――本か、それとも粉か?

key: Something unseeable is in the way.
en: Something unseeable is in the way.
ja: 何か見えない気配が道をふさいでいる。

key: \PN used the Silvon Scope.
en: \PN used the Silvon Scope.
ja: \PNはシルボンスコープを使った。

key: The startled Pokémon attacked!
en: The startled Pokémon attacked!
ja: 驚いたポケモンがおそいかかってきた!

key: I've been reading lots and lots about how to fix stuff!
en: I've been reading lots and lots about how to fix stuff!
ja: ものを直す方法について、たくさんたくさん本を読んでるんだ!

key: My nana says it's important to learn how to do it...
en: My nana says it's important to learn how to do it...
ja: おばあちゃんが、そのやり方を覚えるのは大事なことだって言うから……

key: But just looking at books all day is so boring!
en: But just looking at books all day is so boring!
ja: でも、一日中本ばかり見てるのって、すごく退屈!

key: If I'm gonna fix stuff, I wanna actually DO it!
en: If I'm gonna fix stuff, I wanna actually DO it!
ja: 何かを直すなら、実際にやってみたいんだ!

key: Hey, you mean people are trying to fix lots of things at the Coral Gym?
en: Hey, you mean people are trying to fix lots of things at the Coral Gym?
ja: ねえ、コーラルジムでみんながいろんなものを直そうとしてるってこと?

key: Okay! I've made up my mind!
en: Okay! I've made up my mind!
ja: よし! 決めた!

key: It's a long way from here, but I'm gonna go help out!
en: It's a long way from here, but I'm gonna go help out!
ja: ここからは遠いけど、手伝いに行くよ!

key: I'll check in with my nana eventually. Thanks, stranger!
en: I'll check in with my nana eventually. Thanks, stranger!
ja: おばあちゃんにはあとで連絡するよ。ありがとう!

key: GOTHITELLE: ...
en: GOTHITELLE: ...
ja: ゴチルゼル：……

key: GOTHITELLE: -So, the young one wishes to journey out into the world.-
en: GOTHITELLE: -So, the young one wishes to journey out into the world.-
ja: ゴチルゼル：―そう、あの子は世界へ旅立ちたいのですね。―

key: -She is ill-suited to the life our family leads.-
en: -She is ill-suited to the life our family leads.-
ja: ―あの子には、わたしたち一族の暮らしは向いていません。―

key: -Take her if you wish.-
en: -Take her if you wish.-
ja: ―よろしければ、連れていってあげてください。―

key: -Watch over her.-
en: -Watch over her.-
ja: ―見守ってあげてください。―

key: -Beyond these walls lays reality's most contentious tantrum.-
en: -Beyond these walls lays reality's most contentious tantrum.-
ja: ―この壁の外には、現実のもっとも激しいかんしゃくが待っています。―

key: GOTHITELLE: -We meet again, kind human.-
en: GOTHITELLE: -We meet again, kind human.-
ja: ゴチルゼル：―また会いましたね、優しい人間よ。―

key: -Have you yet come to understand my words from before?-
en: -Have you yet come to understand my words from before?-
ja: ―以前わたしが語った言葉を、あなたはもう理解できましたか?―

key: -You will meet the void.-
en: -You will meet the void.-
ja: ―あなたはいずれ、虚無と出会うでしょう。―

key: -It will embrace you.-
en: -It will embrace you.-
ja: ―それはあなたを抱きしめるでしょう。―

key: -This much is inevitable.-
en: -This much is inevitable.-
ja: ―これだけは避けられません。―

key: -What happens after that, however...-
en: -What happens after that, however...-
ja: ―ですが、その後に何が起こるかは……―

key: -That, not even Arceus must know.-
en: -That, not even Arceus must know.-
ja: ―それは、アルセウスすら知らぬことでしょう。―

key: GOTHITELLE: -Welcome, Trainer.-
en: GOTHITELLE: -Welcome, Trainer.-
ja: ゴチルゼル：―ようこそ、トレーナー。―

key: -Should you require assistance in locating the literature you seek, I will be obliged to find it for you.-
en: -Should you require assistance in locating the literature you seek, I will be obliged to find it for you.-
ja: ―お探しの本が見つからないときは、喜んでお探しいたします。―

key: -Otherwise I will humbly request that you leave me to my service, for I have many years of knowledge left to archive among the dust.-
en: -Otherwise I will humbly request that you leave me to my service, for I have many years of knowledge left to archive among the dust.-
ja: ―そうでなければ、どうかわたしをこの務めに専念させてください。ほこりの中に記録すべき知識は、まだ長い年月分残っておりますので。―

key: GOTHITA: Goth-ii!! Goth!
en: GOTHITA: Goth-ii!! Goth!
ja: ゴチム：ゴチー!! ゴチ!

key: GOTHITA: Goth! Goth-goth!
en: GOTHITA: Goth! Goth-goth!
ja: ゴチム：ゴチ! ゴチゴチ!

key: Gothita seems bored.
en: Gothita seems bored.
ja: ゴチムは退屈しているようだ。

key: GOTHITA: Goth!
en: GOTHITA: Goth!
ja: ゴチム：ゴチ!

key: Goth-, Goth-gothita! Gothita! Goth, Goth, Goth!
en: Goth-, Goth-gothita! Gothita! Goth, Goth, Goth!
ja: ゴチ、ゴチゴチム! ゴチム! ゴチ、ゴチ、ゴチ!

key: Gothita seems to want to join you.
en: Gothita seems to want to join you.
ja: ゴチムは一緒についていきたそうにしている。

key: Would you like to take Gothita with you?
en: Would you like to take Gothita with you?
ja: ゴチムを連れていきますか?

key: TITANIA: "The chandelier plummeted.
en: TITANIA: "The chandelier plummeted.
ja: ティタニア：「シャンデリアが真っ逆さまに落ちた。

key: One thousand glitzing crystal ornaments blitzed through the air to adorn themselves atop the dragon's head, and then crash to the ground like the crown of a king before the guillotine.
en: One thousand glitzing crystal ornaments blitzed through the air to adorn themselves atop the dragon's head, and then crash to the ground like the crown of a king before the guillotine.
ja: きらめく千の水晶の飾りが空を切り裂いて舞い散り、竜の頭上を一瞬だけ飾ったかと思うと、ギロチンにかけられる王の冠のように地に落ちた。

key: The beast was slain.
en: The beast was slain.
ja: 獣は倒された。

key: The knight exhaled, and knew that she had no more to do but step over the lamellar corpse languishing on the foyer floor and ascend the tower to her prize.
en: The knight exhaled, and knew that she had no more to do but step over the lamellar corpse languishing on the foyer floor and ascend the tower to her prize.
ja: 騎士は息を吐き、あとはただ、玄関の床に横たわるよろいの亡骸をまたぎ越え、塔を登って褒賞を手にするだけだと悟った。

key: One kiss, and they would live happily ever after."
en: One kiss, and they would live happily ever after."
ja: 口づけひとつで、ふたりは末永く幸せに暮らすのだ」

key: ???: Ack, it started already?!
en: ???: Ack, it started already?!
ja: ???：うわっ、もう始まってる!?

key: I didn't realize I was late!
en: I didn't realize I was late!
ja: 遅刻してたなんて気づかなかった!

key: PUNK: Sorry-- sorry for the interruption, sorry for the late!
en: PUNK: Sorry-- sorry for the interruption, sorry for the late!
ja: パンクボーイ：ごめん――邪魔してごめん、遅れてごめん!

key: Gosh, I lost track of time.
en: Gosh, I lost track of time.
ja: いやー、時間を忘れちゃってさ。

key: But I'm super excited for the reading-- I wouldn't wanna miss it for the world!
en: But I'm super excited for the reading-- I wouldn't wanna miss it for the world!
ja: でも朗読会、めちゃくちゃ楽しみにしてたんだ――絶対に見逃したくなかったんだよ!

key: I read your book twice already myself.
en: I read your book twice already myself.
ja: あんたの本、もう二回も読んだんだ。

key: I'm not... too old to be here, am I?
en: I'm not... too old to be here, am I?
ja: オレ……ここにいるには歳を取りすぎてたりしないよな?

key: TITANIA: ...Not in spirit, at least.
en: TITANIA: ...Not in spirit, at least.
ja: ティタニア：……少なくとも、心はそうじゃないでしょう。

key: TITANIA: Fairy tales are only seen as being for kids because they have historically been used as a method of moral education and imperative.
en: TITANIA: Fairy tales are only seen as being for kids because they have historically been used as a method of moral education and imperative.
ja: ティタニア：おとぎ話が子ども向けだと思われているのは、歴史的に道徳教育や訓戒の手段として使われてきたからにすぎないわ。

key: A truly good story can be enjoyed by all.
en: A truly good story can be enjoyed by all.
ja: 本当に良い物語は、誰であっても楽しめるものよ。

key: KID: But it's over?
en: KID: But it's over?
ja: 子ども：でも、もう終わりなの?

key: You said, "happily ever after," so--
en: You said, "happily ever after," so--
ja: 「末永く幸せに暮らしました」って言ったよね、だから――

key: That means it's over, right?
en: That means it's over, right?
ja: それって、終わりってことだよね?

key: TITANIA: I did say that.
en: TITANIA: I did say that.
ja: ティタニア：たしかにそう言ったわ。

key: But you see,
en: But you see,
ja: でもね、

key: That was only the prologue.
en: That was only the prologue.
ja: あれはまだ序章にすぎないの。

key: "Chapter 1: The Princess with a Heart of Glass"
en: "Chapter 1: The Princess with a Heart of Glass"
ja: 「第一章:ガラスの心を持つ王女」

key: All these new books are garbage.
en: All these new books are garbage.
ja: 最近の新しい本なんて全部くだらん。

key: It's just unrealistic to include gay characters, let alone transgenders.
en: It's just unrealistic to include gay characters, let alone transgenders.
ja: ゲイのキャラクターを出すなんて非現実的だ、ましてやトランスジェンダーなんて論外だ。

key: Isn't that just a plot of the odious progressive agenda?!
en: Isn't that just a plot of the odious progressive agenda?!
ja: それこそ、忌まわしいリベラルの陰謀ってやつじゃないのか!?

key: Who is going to look out for the straight men!?
en: Who is going to look out for the straight men!?
ja: ストレートの男たちのことは、いったい誰が気にかけてくれるんだ!?

key: And what's this about genderless PEOPLE?!
en: And what's this about genderless PEOPLE?!
ja: それに、性別のない「人間」とやらは何なんだ!?

key: It's bad enough when you meet someone who has blue hair and pronouns,
en: It's bad enough when you meet someone who has blue hair and pronouns,
ja: 青い髪をして代名詞がどうこう言う奴に会うだけでもうんざりなのに、

key: But now we have to deal with it in entertainment too?
en: But now we have to deal with it in entertainment too?
ja: 娯楽の中にまでそんなものが出てくるのを我慢しなきゃいけないのか?

key: It was bad enough when they put "xyr"s into existing media, but now they're out there making their own work to brainwash the population!
en: It was bad enough when they put "xyr"s into existing media, but now they're out there making their own work to brainwash the population!
ja: 既存のメディアに「xyr」なんてものをねじ込まれるだけでもうんざりだったのに、今度は自分たちで作品を作って民衆を洗脳しようとしてるじゃないか!

key: How much more can we as a society take?
en: How much more can we as a society take?
ja: 社会として、いったいどこまで我慢しなきゃならないんだ?

key: They talk about non-binary, but if you ask me, the only binary they care about is whether you're 'woke' or not!
en: They talk about non-binary, but if you ask me, the only binary they care about is whether you're 'woke' or not!
ja: ノンバイナリーがどうとか言うが、あいつらが本当に気にしてる二元論なんて「目覚めてる」か「目覚めてないか」だけだろうが!

key: You wanna be woke!?
en: You wanna be woke!?
ja: 目覚めたいのか!?

key: Why don't you go try telling the next person who asks you for a password "monowoke" if you're so goddamn progressive!?
en: Why don't you go try telling the next person who asks you for a password "monowoke" if you're so goddamn progressive!?
ja: そんなにリベラルが自慢なら、今度パスワードを聞かれたときに「モノウォーク」とでも言ってみろ!

key: Get out of here with this trash!
en: Get out of here with this trash!
ja: こんなゴミ、とっとと持って失せろ!

en: \PN obtained Field Effect Read-Out 10!
ja: \PNはフィールド効果解説書10を手に入れた!

key: Info on Corrosive Field now available!
en: Info on Corrosive Field now available!
ja: 腐食フィールドの情報が見られるようになった!

en: Yes
